## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:records`, `pm:blocked` on the decision card #22505

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T15:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** members cannot react to anyone else's comment at all. The console offers the button on every comment, the click fails with 403, and an external app's guide promises the feature.
- **Why a decision, not a direction.** The floor is deliberate: only the author updates a `sys_comment` row (`plugin-security`, with a moderation alternate). Each fix either loosens that floor, which is the maintainer's call, or changes `reactions`' published storage shape, which goes to the decision box. Filed as **#22505**:
  - A: each reaction is the reactor's own record;
  - B: one narrow reaction action;
  - C: a column exception to the floor;
  - D: no member reactions.

  The recommendation is A, with B as the fallback. ⛔ C loosens a security floor, and ⛔ D deletes a published capability.
- ⛔ The author-only edit of a comment's text stays under every option, as this card says.
- **Blocked-by:** #22505 (now in this body). This card closes through the PR that executes the ruling.

Blocker moved · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `session_013j5gkUCpqQiti4GgPqqmnt` · 2026-10-10T01:17Z

- **The decision is made.** #22505 was ruled A, amended (`6091550406`, supplement `6091621568`). A reaction becomes the reactor's own `sys_comment_reaction` record. `sys_comment.reactions` retires, with no aggregate and no data migration. The author-only floor on `sys_comment` stays.
- **The card this one waits on now** is the platform card that executes the ruling, objectstack-ai/objectstack#22566. This body's `Blocked-by:` line was rewritten in this act, from #22505 to #22566. The state stays `pm:blocked`.
- **The objectui half** is the chatter's write and read of reaction records. It is asked of triage on #22505.
- **Closing:** this card closes on the PRs that execute the ruling (the record's Execution line). The member-visible fix needs both halves.

Blocker moved, and a hand-off for the application grant · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `session_013j5gkUCpqQiti4GgPqqmnt` · 2026-10-10T06:25Z

**#22566 landed** (PR #22603, `29a163f571` on `main`). A comment reaction is now its reactor's own `sys_comment_reaction` record, one row per comment, emoji and user. A member reacts to any comment they can read, and deletes only their own reaction. The author-only edit rule on `sys_comment` is unchanged.

**This card stays `pm:blocked`.** Line 1 now reads `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12078`. The console's chatter still writes `sys_comment.reactions` until that card moves it to the new records. The column itself retires in #22573, after the console pin carries objectui#12078.

**Hand-off to the `repo:hotcrm` seat (this session cannot write to hotcrm).** The platform's `everyone` baseline grants nothing on the new object, by the maintainer's ruling recorded on `member_default` (seat answer `6093553917` on #22566, open to the maintainer's veto). An application that shows reactions grants `sys_comment_reaction` **read, create and delete** in the same permission set that grants `sys_comment` (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2043 is where hotcrm grants `sys_comment`). The platform's own-record rule (`owner_only_deletes`) keeps a delete to the reactor, so the app's delete bit does not let a member remove another member's reaction. Without the grant, a member's first reaction answers a loud `403`, not a silent half-feature. The grant needs a hotcrm release that consumes the `@objectstack/plugin-audit` version carrying #22566.

## Unlock scan: objectstack-ai/objectui#12078 closed (objectui `de302c7315`), but the console pin does not carry it yet. `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T10:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: none

- **What landed:** objectui `main` `de302c7315`. The chatter reads and writes reactions as the member's own `sys_comment_reaction` records (objectui PR #12090).
- **What has not happened yet:** this repo's `.objectui-sha` is `20c6d351ad` (2026-10-09T22:57Z), which does not contain `de302c7315`. The console this repo serves still writes `sys_comment.reactions`.
- **Restart-when:** objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carries objectui `de302c7315`. Then:
  - this defect is fixed in the served console, and the card closes `completed` after one reading on `main`: a member reacts to another member's comment;
  - the application grant noted in `6094633923` (hotcrm's `sys_comment_reaction` read, create and delete) stays with the `repo:hotcrm` seat.

## Restart: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. The console pin on `main` carries objectui `de302c7315`; what remains is the closing reading

`domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) · `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA` · 2026-10-11T18:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Thread-read: `6096768082`.

- **The hold's restart condition (`6096768082`), "objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carries objectui `de302c7315`", run in this act:** `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` is `4997995022` (PR #22794, `ea9fd99dd`). `git merge-base --is-ancestor de302c7315 4997995022` exits 0 on an objectui clone fetched in this act.
- **Release double check:** ① this is the condition of the newest transition comment on this card (`6096768082`); ② no PR referencing this card has merged since that comment (the newest merged reference is PR #22603, earlier).
- **What this card now asks, as the hold set it:** one reading on `main`, where a member reacts to another member's comment, and then the card closes `completed`. The application grant in `6094633923` stays with the `repo:hotcrm` seat.

## Closed `completed`: a member reacts to another member's comment, on `main` and in the console the pin serves

`domain:services` seat 2 (#21118) · `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA` · 2026-10-11T19:43Z. Thread-read: `6112525227`.

This is the closing reading the hold (`6096768082`) and the restart (`6112525227`) set.

- **Server, on `main` `b1d701b60`:** a reaction is its reactor's own `sys_comment_reaction` record (#22566, PR #22603, `29a163f571`), so a member's reaction no longer updates another user's `sys_comment` row. Two integration pins run in Test Core on every `main` commit, unchanged since `29a163f57`; Test Core passed on `b1d701b60` in its merge-queue run:
  - `plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-access.integration.test.ts`, "a member reacts to ANOTHER member's comment, and the row is theirs";
  - `plugin-security/src/comment-reaction-own-record-floor.test.ts`, "a member reacts to another member's comment and removes the reaction again" and "another member cannot delete it".
  - The author-only edit of a comment's text is unchanged, as the card required.
- **Console, at the pin `4997995022`** (an objectui clone read by the seat in this act): `RecordDetailView.tsx` takes the `records` store whenever the deployment declares `sys_comment_reaction`, which this framework does. A reaction is created as the member's own row and deleted as that row. The `sys_comment.reactions` column path stays only where the object is absent (a v17 framework), and that column retires in #22573.
- **Still owed outside this repository:** an application that shows reactions grants `sys_comment_reaction` read, create and delete beside its `sys_comment` grant. This was handed to the `repo:hotcrm` seat in `6094633923`, and it stays there. Until then, a member's first reaction answers a loud `403`, never a silent one.
- **State:** `pm:queue` comes off and the card closes `completed`. No PR references it.
